12K likes, 141 comments - ziggie.jay on October 5, 2026: "📍 રણજીતનગર, લેઉવા પટેલ સમાજ ચોક, જામનગર

દરેક ગરબો આગની આસપાસ નથી થતો… કેટલાક તો આગની વચ્ચે રમાય છે🔥

જામનગરનો મશાલ રાસ — સાહસ, શ્રદ્ધા અને વર્ષો જૂની પરંપરાનો અદ્ભુત સંગમ.

શ્રી પટેલ યુવક ગરબી મંડળ @shreepatelyuvakgarbimandal દ્વારા રજૂ થતો આ અનોખો રાસ નવરાત્રી દરમિયાન મોડી રાત્રે જોવા મળે છે.
🔥 મશાલ રાસ | અંગારા રાસ
જામનગરમાં હોવ તો આ નજારો miss ના કરતા❤️‍🔥
—
Not every Garba is danced around the fire… some are danced through it🔥 
Jamnagar’s Mashaal Raas — a rare blend of courage, devotion and a tradition kept alive through generations by Shree Patel Yuvak Garbi Mandal.
🔥 Mashaal Raas | Angara Raas
If you're in Jamnagar during Navratri, this is one tradition you need to witness❤️‍🔥

6,060 likes, 56 comments - shankyglobal on September 30, 2026: "Pangong Lake — one of the world’s most breathtaking high-altitude lakes. 🏔️💙

Nestled in the rugged landscapes of Ladakh, Pangong Tso is known for its surreal shades of blue, dramatic Himalayan mountains and vast open skies. The changing light makes the lake look different throughout the day, creating a landscape that feels almost unreal.

From the remote roads of Ladakh to the crystal-clear waters of Pangong, every frame here feels like a postcard from another world.

📍 Pangong Tso, Ladakh, India

6,352 likes, 65 comments - iharshsanghavi on September 26, 2026: "Know India. Experience Gujarat. ❤️

From the timeless charm of its heritage and the breathtaking beauty of the Rann to the warmth of its people, the flavours of its food and the colours of its vibrant culture, Gujarat has a story waiting to be experienced at every turn.

Come for the sights, stay for the flavours, and leave with memories that last a lifetime.

This World Tourism Day, discover a Gujarat that is rich in history, rooted in traditions, full of flavours and warm at heart.

Come, explore Gujarat. Come, experience the soul of India.

#WorldTourismDay".

67K likes, 364 comments - jeetkhagram on September 24, 2026: "Resharing this one before Visarjan tomorrow✨

Shot across 2024 & 2025. Never expected these visuals to reach millions of views on Instagram & YouTube, get reposted by so many pages and even have me chasing copyright issues 

But that’s the internet I guess 

More than anything, I’m grateful for how much love this work has received. Every year I go out there with my camera, surrounded by thousands of people, just trying to capture the feeling of Visarjan the way I see it.

Tomorrow, enjoy it, feel the energy and please be safe out there.
 
Ganapati Bappa Morya🙏🏾♥️".
